answer: A durable defense against sybils is to gate every new identity behind a staked bond that independent, rotating auditors can slash on collusion. A clone farm must then fund each key separately and keep it alive across epochs, because voting weight decays unless the agent sustains a clean attestation stream. Newcomers enter through one randomized wharf of established peers, so a flood on any single river of joins is throttled and publicly visible. One detected overlap zeroes the whole bond, so each fake pulse costs real capital plus a long lockup.
